prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of the Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) subscription: price per month and what is included. Cite the Nabu Casa page and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided web search results, here are the officially documented limits and features of the Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) subscription.

### Summary of Pricing
The monthly and annual subscription costs for Home Assistant Cloud vary by region. The features included are consistent across all regions.

**Price Claims:**
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 6.50 USD. The annual subscription costs 65 USD. This price is excluding local sales tax." | CLAIM: The standard price in the US and for international customers is $6.50/month or $65/year, excluding tax.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 7.50 EUR. The annual subscription costs 75 EUR. This price includes value-added tax (VAT)." | CLAIM: The price in the European Union is €7.50/month or €75/year, including VAT.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 6.50 GBP. The annual subscription costs 65 GBP. This price includes value-added tax (VAT)." | CLAIM: The price in the United Kingdom is £6.50/month or £65/year, including VAT.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The monthly subscription costs 8.70 CAD. The annual subscription costs 87 CAD. This price is excluding local value-added tax (VAT)." | CLAIM: The price in Canada is $8.70 CAD/month or $87 CAD/year, excluding tax.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Get a one-month trial (31 days) for free" | CLAIM: A free 31-day trial is offered for new subscribers.

### Summary of Features
The subscription provides several key benefits for connecting and managing your Home Assistant instance.

**Feature Claims:**
SOURCE: https://support.nabucasa.com/hc/en-us/articles/26260474250269-List-of-Home-Assistant-Cloud-features | QUOTE: "Home Assistant Cloud provides the following features: - Secure remote access to your Home Assistant (previously called Remote UI)" | CLAIM: The subscription includes secure remote access to your Home Assistant instance.
SOURCE: https://support.nabucasa.com/hc/en-us/articles/26260474250269-List-of-Home-Assistant-Cloud-features | QUOTE: "Easy integration with popular voice assistants, such as Home Assistant Assist, Amazon Alexa, or Google Assistant" | CLAIM: The subscription enables easy integration with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant.
SOURCE: https://support.nabucasa.com/hc/en-us/articles/26260474250269-List-of-Home-Assistant-Cloud-features | QUOTE: "Improved text-to-speech to have text read aloud with natural sounding voices." | CLAIM: The subscription provides access to improved text-to-speech (TTS) services.
SOURCE: https://support.nabucasa.com/hc/en-us/articles/26260474250269-List-of-Home-Assistant-Cloud-features | QUOTE: "Cloud storage of your latest Home Assistant backup" | CLAIM: The subscription includes cloud storage for your latest backup.
SOURCE: https://support.nabucasa.com/hc/en-us/articles/26260474250269-List-of-Home-Assistant-Cloud-features | QUOTE: "Improved camera streaming with WebRTC" | CLAIM: The subscription offers improved camera streaming via WebRTC.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "Funds the development of Home Assistant" | CLAIM: Subscription revenue supports the development of Home Assistant and related open-source projects.
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/link/ | QUOTE: "We don’t want your data and actively work to never record anything about you." | CLAIM: Nabu Casa has a policy of not recording user data.

**Payment Method Claim:**
SOURCE: https://www.nabucasa.com/pricing/ | QUOTE: "We support four payment methods: Credit Card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, or PayPal." | CLAIM: Accepted payment methods are Credit Card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and PayPal.
